items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (förmliche Zustellung, Zustellungsurkunde per § 182 ZPO); the attached cover page states the actual delivery date, 'zugestellt am 18.10.2027' (Monday). For a formal service there is no 3/4-day deemed-delivery fiction; the stated delivery day itself starts the period. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (18.10.2027) is not counted; the two-week (14-day) period under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB would end Monday 01.11.2027. That day is Allerheiligen, a public holiday in Saarland, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next working day, Tuesday 02.11.2027.

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs (after the Bescheid becomes final)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Betrag nicht vor Rechtskraft dieses Bescheids; danach ist er innerhalb von zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE18 5900 0000 0003 8400 00 unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens zu überweisen.
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final). Rechtskraft occurs at the end of the Einspruch period computed above, i.e. at the end of Tuesday 02.11.2027, provided no Einspruch is filed. Counting the two-week payment period under § 187 Abs. 1 / § 188 Abs. 2 BGB from the day after Rechtskraft (03.11.2027) gives Tuesday 16.11.2027, which is a normal working day in Saarland, so no further shift applies. This date assumes no Einspruch is lodged; filing an Einspruch would suspend Rechtskraft and this payment deadline entirely.

warnings: The letter is a Bußgeldbescheid (fine notice) with a formal Postzustellung; page 2 is a copy of the delivery envelope's front, on which the postal carrier (Zusteller) has entered 'zugestellt am 18.10.2027' — this actual service date, not the printed letter date of 11.10.2027, is what starts the two-week Einspruch period.

The letter itself instructs 'zahlen Sie den Betrag nicht vor Rechtskraft dieses Bescheids' — do not pay before the objection period has expired without an Einspruch being filed; paying early is not required and the payment deadline above only applies if no Einspruch is lodged.

The IBAN DE18 5900 0000 0003 8400 00 is a well-formed German IBAN (Saarländische Musterkasse, BLZ 59000000) but a valid IBAN does not prove the payee; compare it against the bank details on the official Saarland Bußgeldbehörde website before paying, and check the payee name match your bank reports (Empfängerüberprüfung).
